post.description:
Look up a public Hugging Face LoRA and propose registration choices.

The response fills revision, weights file, base-model family, name, strength,
and trigger words when the model card knows them. It does not register an
adapter, download weight tensors, or spend provider credits. Several equally
plausible weight files stay unselected until the caller chooses one.

schema.title: Response Preview Adapter Source V1 Adapters Source Preview Post

post.description:
Suggest a project LoRA or a public Hugging Face LoRA without registering it.

A project alias, adapter id, or unique display name becomes a generation patch.
A link becomes a suggestion the caller can show and later accept. This does not
download weight tensors or spend provider credits.

schema.title: Response Suggest Lora V1 Adapters Suggestions Post

post.summary: Use or Add a Suggested LoRA
post.description:
Use a project LoRA, or register an unambiguous public one and then use it.

Registration happens only when a weights file is known. Several weight files,
or a missing base model, return the same choice the suggestion would have shown.
This does not generate an image or spend provider credits.

estimateId.title: Estimateid

externalRef.title: Externalref
externalRef.description: Opaque caller-owned correlation reference. Never sent to providers. Max 255 characters.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Caller-owned flat labels for correlation and future exact-match filtering. At most 32 tags; each tag max 256 characters.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Opaque caller-owned JSON bookkeeping. Never interpreted or sent to providers. Serialized size capped at 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

readerDelivery.description: On a durable text job, publish job.reader_text events during the one provider call, before the receipt is sealed. Replay with GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/events?type=job.reader_text. Not streaming invoke. Uses standard processing. Does not change the selected route.

inputPayloadRef.title: Inputpayloadref
inputPayloadRef.description: Verified payload id from POST /v1/payloads. When set, inline input is optional; the server resolves content before admission, estimate, and stream dispatch.

tags.description: Caller-owned flat labels for correlation and future exact-match filtering. At most 32 tags; each tag max 256 characters.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Opaque caller-owned JSON bookkeeping. Never interpreted or sent to providers. Serialized size capped at 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

readerDelivery.description: On a durable text job, publish job.reader_text events during the one provider call, before the receipt is sealed. Replay with GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}/events?type=job.reader_text. Not streaming invoke. Uses standard processing. Does not change the selected route.

inputPayloadRef.title: Inputpayloadref
inputPayloadRef.description: Verified payload id from POST /v1/payloads. When set, inline input is optional; the server resolves content before admission, estimate, and stream dispatch.

runHint.title: Runhint
runHint.description: Shortest valid way to run this match, projected from the same server-side descriptor as GET /v1/capabilities/{key} (cli/sdk/mcp, requiredInputFields, and a structured --input-file variant when simple sugar cannot express the input). Discovery output must never hand out a command the capability rejects.

accessDecision.description: Authenticated workspace access for this match. Null for anonymous resolution. Suitability and current runnability are separate facts.

quoteId.title: Quoteid
quoteId.description: Commission quote for a capability REQUEST. Humans pay at approvalUrl. Never pass this id as execution.quoteId on jobs or invoke.

notExecutionQuoteId.title: Notexecutionquoteid
notExecutionQuoteId.description: This quoteId is not valid for job execution.quoteId.

CapabilityRequestView.title: CapabilityRequestView
CapabilityRequestView.description: Public view of a capability request. Quote/payment authority stays on CapabilityQuoteView.

CapabilityResolutionRequirements.title: CapabilityResolutionRequirements
CapabilityResolutionRequirements.description:
Supported resolver constraints.

Requirements are deliberately small and closed. Hydracept must reject a
requirement it cannot honor instead of accepting arbitrary keys that silently
disappear. ``runnableNow`` is evaluated only with authenticated workspace
context; catalog-only resolution cannot answer it.

ComputeLevel.title: ComputeLevel
ComputeLevel.description: Provider-neutral inference effort requested by the routing authority.

ExactTargetPin.title: ExactTargetPin
ExactTargetPin.description: Exact execution target. Hydracept does not substitute.

autoSelect.title: Autoselect
autoSelect.description: Opt in to smart fallback when preferredModel is physically unavailable. Ignored when preferredModel is omitted.

budgetEnforcement.title: Budgetenforcement
budgetEnforcement.description: warn (admit over ceiling) or prevent (HTTP 402). Setting maxCostUsd without this is prevent.

maxDurationSeconds.title: Maxdurationseconds
maxDurationSeconds.description: Provider execution deadline in seconds after the job starts running. Does not include queue wait. timeoutSeconds is accepted as an alias.

actualCost.title: Actualcost
actualCost.description: Provider cost when the receipt has evidence for it; null when unknown. Never the customer charge (that is pricing.charge.customerCharge) and never a fabricated 0.

pricing.description: Canonical terminal pricing once a receipt is sealed: charge (customer) and providerCost (provider cost evidence) as distinct dimensions.

progress.description: Latest projection of the job's job.progress events; absent until one exists.

requestSnapshot.title: Requestsnapshot
requestSnapshot.description: Canonical submitted request for rerunning the same inputs in Studio (not the sealed receipt).

approval.title: Approval
approval.description: Sanitized human-gate payload. Present only while the job awaits approval.

HydraceptJobProgress.title: HydraceptJobProgress
HydraceptJobProgress.description:
Where a durable job has reached, as reported by the activity that owns the work.

``updatedAt`` is required whenever progress is present, so a reader can always tell
how fresh the projection is. ``percent`` and ``etaSeconds`` are optional on purpose:
they are present only when the authority (a provider that reports them) can compute
them. Unknown values are omitted rather than defaulted to ``0``.

HydraceptJobResult.title: HydraceptJobResult
HydraceptJobResult.description: First-class job result projection — typed output plus payload identity.

estimatedCost.title: Estimatedcost
estimatedCost.description: Legacy compatibility field mirroring pricing.quote.customerTotal. Prefer pricing.quote.

actualCost.title: Actualcost
actualCost.description: Legacy compatibility field mirroring pricing.charge.customerCharge. Prefer pricing.charge.

estimateId.title: Estimateid
estimateId.description: Inbound/outbound alias of quoteId. Prefer quoteId and pricing.quote.

price.description: Retail price of the capability for this execution. Independent of wallet debit.

HydraceptReceiptPricing.title: HydraceptReceiptPricing
HydraceptReceiptPricing.description: Canonical pricing on a receipt. Legacy micros fields remain for compatibility.

HydraceptSampling.title: HydraceptSampling
HydraceptSampling.description: Optional product-requested sampling. Providers that reject custom sampling omit these.

Money.title: Money
Money.description: Hydracept price before transactional tax. ``amountMicros`` is authority.

PresentationMoney.title: PresentationMoney
PresentationMoney.description: Optional converted display of a charge. Not part of the financial receipt.

ReaderDelivery.title: ReaderDelivery
ReaderDelivery.description:
Opt in to partial text output on a durable text job.

``boundary`` is ``paragraph``: events close on a blank line, or on a
sentence-sized span once the hold limit is reached. Tokens are not events.

customerCharge.description: Amount the customer owes Hydracept for this execution. $0 when Hydracept covers it.

customerDebit.description: Amount actually removed from a customer-visible stored balance.

ReceiptProviderCost.title: ReceiptProviderCost
ReceiptProviderCost.description:
Provider cost evidence. ``amount`` is null when unknown — never ``0``.

``basis``/``status`` explain how the amount was obtained; a usage-priced cost
names the pinned ``priceScheduleId`` so a later catalog change cannot silently
rewrite historical provider cost.

RetailEstimateRequest.title: RetailEstimateRequest
RetailEstimateRequest.description:
Quote request using the same canonical envelope as invoke/jobs.

Legacy top-level fields (``billingMode``, ``options``, top-level ``model``)
are normalized into ``context`` / ``input`` / ``execution`` before validation.

estimateId.title: Estimateid
estimateId.description: Alias of quoteId for older clients. Prefer quoteId and pricing.quote.

expectedCharge.description: Legacy alias of pricing.quote.customerTotal. Prefer pricing.quote.

maximumAuthorizedCharge.description: Legacy alias of pricing.quote.maximumCustomerTotal. Prefer pricing.quote.

RetailEstimateResponse.title: RetailEstimateResponse
RetailEstimateResponse.description: Retail quote before execution. ``estimateId`` mirrors ``quoteId`` for compatibility.

estimateEndpoint.title: Estimateendpoint
estimateEndpoint.description: HTTP alias of quoteEndpoint (same 0.3 retail quote).

ScaledFxRate.title: ScaledFxRate
ScaledFxRate.description: FX snapshot using scaled integers — never IEEE binary floats.

SurfaceActionInputField.title: SurfaceActionInputField
SurfaceActionInputField.description: Generic action input. Values are collected by the host and sent as operation input.

TargetRoutingRecord.title: TargetRoutingRecord
TargetRoutingRecord.description: Which target ran. Profile stays null until a real routing profile is published.

ValidationGate.title: ValidationGate
